"'''Nash's Race Day / The Lost Jedi Ship'''" is the second episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 4]], [[2023]]<ref name="D23 May" /> with an early screening on [[April 8]], 2023 at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]].<ref name="Celebration" />

==Official description==
''Nash's Jedi friends help her compete in a race. The young Jedi find a long-lost Jedi ship.''
